```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/fig_admin_map.R")
source("R/fig_timeline.R")
source("R/fig_health_system.R")
source("R/fig_data_flow.R")
slug       <- "mozambique"
admin_text <- fig_admin_map_text(slug)
tl_text    <- fig_timeline_text(slug)
tl_height  <- fig_timeline_height(slug)
hs_text    <- fig_health_system_text(slug)
hs_height  <- fig_health_system_height(slug)
df_text    <- fig_data_flow_text(slug)
df_height  <- fig_data_flow_height(slug)
```

## Administrative boundaries

```{r}
#| label: fig-admin

fig_admin_map(slug)
```

**Source:** `r admin_text$source`
